INSERT INTO dislike
user_id, blog_id, comment_id, dislike_time,
#{userId}, #{blogId}, #{commentId}, #{dislikeTime},
mapper.select: SELECT b.id, b.title, b.content, b.create_time AS createTime, b.publish_time AS publishTime, b.update_time AS updateTime, b.views, b.likes, b.dislikes, b.collections, b.shares, b.comments, b.user_id AS userId, u.username, u.avatar, b.category_id AS categoryId, c.name AS category, b.status, b.is_top AS isTop, b.cover FROM dislike d INNER JOIN blog b ON d.blog_id = b.id INNER JOIN user u ON b.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN category c ON b.category_id = c.id WHERE d.user_id = #{userId} AND d.blog_id IS NOT NULL AND d.comment_id IS NULL ORDER BY d.dislike_time DESC
